enforcedBy: schema/semantic_validate.py (GRAPH_RULES registry; verify_all.py checks the ids and severities match)

rules.description: The node sequence must match the declared template's node list: required nodes present, order preserved, no extra or duplicated non-repeatable nodes, node variant equal to the template node's variant.
A registered route must use its bound template; template.home only at '/', template.not-found only at '*', template.legal-prose never at '/' or '*'.
A legal-prose PageSpec at a route not in templates/routes.json is allowed but flagged (new page, no measured counterpart).
chrome.splash appears only on template.home and only as node 0.
chrome.header appears exactly once: immediately after the splash on home, first on legal-prose.
At most one hero.title per page.
exceptions: template.legal-prose and template.not-found have no hero at all; zero heroes is valid

rules.description: When present, conversion.cta-video is immediately followed by chrome.footer.
chrome.footer may only be followed by chrome.subfooter; chrome.subfooter is always last.
Every section type has maxPerPage 1 (constraints.maxPerPage in its contract) except content.legal-section (repeatable, maxPerPage 12: 8 measured on /privacy-policy, ceiling inferred).
No more than 2 consecutive scroll-driven sections (scrollStage: story-reveal, values sticky-stack, team roster).
exceptions: narrative.story-reveal -> values.sticky-stack is the observed maximum run of 2 on the home page and is valid

rules.description: Adjacent painted sections (transparent chrome.header skipped) should change surface colour.
Header navItems anchors must resolve: on home to anchorIds present on the same page; on legal-prose to anchors of template.home sections.
anchorId values are unique within a page.
Story reveal units (intro words + merger logos + statement words) must be <= 60, else trailing words never reveal in the reference implementation.
values.sticky-stack has exactly five panels (geometry and '/5' counter are hardcoded).
chrome.header variant must match its motion pattern (home: scroll-scrub-logo-scale; legal: menu-slide-200ms).
At most 2 sections with autoplay ambient video per page (home has 2: title and CTA).
Every media object satisfies its assetRole's generationPolicy (assetRefPattern); roles with policy 'omit' must not appear at all.
Every text field respects its contract x-maxWords (including each legal paragraph and part heading), counted per instance.

modeRulesNote: Composition rules only. Mode (GENERATION_MODE_*, CLONE_MODE_SOURCE_REF), token (TOKEN_*) and repo-integrity pins are enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py and documented in policy/design-policy.json and tokens/llm/token-policy.json; they apply in addition to every rule here.
